hero.caption: Aerial view of Soekarno-Hatta International Airport, Jakarta (edited horizon). The view taken in 1 February 2010 from Garuda Indonesia airplane during take-off. The architecture reflect Indonesian vernacular architecture of Javanese Joglo roof  with Pendopo as gate lounges (waiting hall) surrounded with tropical gardens.
